description: Represents a UI metric readout component (D04), typically used in dashboards to display key performance indicators (KPIs) with trend analysis, status indicators, and historical context.
title: Metric Readout

id.description: Unique identifier for the metric readout component instance.

label.description: The display label for the metric, usually shown above or beside the value.

value.description: The formatted string representation of the metric value to be displayed in the UI. May include currency symbols, separators, or unit suffixes.

rawValue.description: The raw numeric value of the metric, useful for client-side graphing or conditional logic.

unit.description: The unit of measurement associated with the value (e.g., 'USD', 'kg', 'users', '%').

trend.description: The direction of the trend compared to the previous comparison period. Used to render directional arrows or indicators.

changePercentage.description: The percentage change relative to the previous period. Positive values indicate growth, negative values indicate decline.

changeAbsolute.description: The absolute numerical difference compared to the previous period.

status.description: The semantic status or severity level associated with the metric, often used to determine the color of the readout (e.g., Green for SUCCESS, Red for DANGER).

description.description: A verbose description or tooltip text explaining the context or calculation method of the metric.
description.example: The total number of unique users who have logged in within the last 24 hours.

icon.description: A reference identifier for an icon to display alongside the metric (e.g., FontAwesome class or SVG ID).

comparisonLabel.description: Text describing the period or baseline the current value is being compared against.

timestamp.description: The exact timestamp when this metric was calculated or last updated.
